about_the_game:
100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time.

Expected playtime: 1 hour.

Don't let the Robugs win! Lead the underdog forces of the 100th Bug Brigade and defend your home tree! Though the battle is dire, hope rests with you!

Clever tactics utilizing each member's unique active and passive abilities can turn the tide of the war.

Possess your enemies, throw your allies, or put your life on the line for an ultimate attack. Use the ability tooltips to exploit every aspect of your team's abilities to overcome the odds.

Manipulate the battlefield to your advantage (or the Robugs will!).

Dynamic battlefields altered by your actions and the story combined. Retake conquered areas, revealing new bosses and environmental mechanics. But beware! If the Robugs can't chomp on you- they'll chomp on your defenses.

Understand the emotions of the 100th Bug Brigade to discover hidden strengths and weaknesses.

The Robugs may not have feelings, but your team does. Use clues from their dialogue on the battlefield to uncover strategies against the unfeeling Robugs. But if the Robugs don't feel, what motivates them...?

You are not alone! Though you are their leader, the 100th Bug Brigade will serve not just as your soldiers, but also your advisors during battle.

New to tactics or roleplaying games? Don't worry. The 100th Bug Brigade, and the development team behind them, have got your back. We designed the game to be accessible to new players, while retaining the depth of strategy that veterans expect.
